Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for North Dakota, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 27,174 covered jobs
B. 17,068 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, North Dakota statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/38000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
